news.body: The analyst fair value estimate for Indian Energy Exchange has moved from roughly ₹270 to about ₹236. The lower target reflects updated views on revenue growth, profitability, discount rates and the P/E multiple that analysts are now willing to apply.

news.title: Final dividend increased to ₹2.00
news.body: Dividend of ₹2.00 is 33% higher than last year. Ex-date: 15th May 2026 Payment date: 1st January 1970 Dividend yield will be 2.8%, which is higher than the industry average of 1.3%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is covered by both earnings (56% earnings payout ratio) and cash flows (64% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 19% per year over the past 8 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 10% over the next 2 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS in line with analyst expectations despite revenue beat
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹5.54 (up from ₹4.83 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹7.47b (up 14% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹4.93b (up 15% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 66% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.6%. Earnings per share (EPS) were mostly in line with analyst estimates. Revenue is expected to decline by 6.8% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, while revenues in the Capital Markets industry in India are expected to grow by 16%. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 17% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 8% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: Indian Energy Exchange Limited Recommends Final Dividend for the Financial Year Ended March 31, 2026
news.body: The board of director of Indian Energy Exchange Limited meeting held on April 23, 2026, recommended a final dividend of INR 2 per equity share (face value INR 1 each) for the financial year ended 31 March 2026. The Board has fixed 15 May 2026 as the Record Date to determine which shareholders will be eligible to receive the dividend, if and only if it is approved at the AGM. If shareholders approve the dividend at the AGM, the final dividend will be paid within 30 days from the date of shareholder approval.

This change reflects updated assumptions around the discount rate and future P/E that analysts consider better aligned with recent valuation work across broader research coverage.

news.title: IEX: Weaker Revenue Visibility Will Challenge Confidence In 105 Fair Value
news.body: Analysts are keeping their fair value estimate for Indian Energy Exchange steady at ₹105.00, reflecting only slight adjustments in assumptions around discount rate, revenue contraction, and profit margin, while their overall long-term valuation view remains largely unchanged. Analyst Commentary Analysts covering Indian Energy Exchange appear to be taking a measured stance, keeping the fair value estimate anchored at ₹105.00 while tweaking inputs such as discount rate and margin assumptions.

news.title: IEX: Softer Revenue Outlook Will Test Confidence In 105 Fair Value
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for Indian Energy Exchange steady at ₹105.00. They have tweaked their assumptions with a lower discount rate and a slightly softer revenue growth outlook, alongside a higher projected profit margin and a modestly lower future P/E multiple.

news.title: IEX: Strong Margins And Power Market Volumes Will Support Forward Confidence
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their fair value estimate for Indian Energy Exchange from ₹149.50 to about ₹144.64. This reflects updated assumptions around slightly softer revenue, stronger profit margins and a lower assumed future P/E multiple.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.34 (up from ₹1.21 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.83b (up 14% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.19b (up 11% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 65% (down from 67% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) surpassed analyst estimates by 3.1%. Revenue is expected to decline by 4.8% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, while revenues in the Capital Markets industry in India are expected to grow by 16%. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 17% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 3% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: Indian Energy Exchange Limited Announces Dividend for the Financial Year 2025-26
news.body: Indian Energy Exchange Limited at its Board of Directors meeting held January 29, 2026 has approved the payment of an interim dividend of INR 1.50/- per equity share having a face value of INR 1/- each for the financial year 2025-26. The Record Date for ascertaining the name of members/beneficial owners entitled to receive the Interim Dividend is February 04, 2026.

news.body: After last week's 15% share price gain to ₹155, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 28x. Average forward P/E is 36x in the Capital Markets industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 14% over the past three years. Simply Wall St's valuation model estimates the intrinsic value at ₹65.07 per share.

news.title: IEX: Power Market Volumes And Regulation Will Shape Balanced Forward Outlook
news.body: Analysts have made a marginal downward revision to their price target on Indian Energy Exchange to Rs 149.50, trimming it by less than Rs 1 as they fine tune discount rate and earnings assumptions while maintaining confidence in the company’s long term profitability and valuation framework. Analyst Commentary Recent commentary from bullish analysts underscores that the marginal cut to the price target is primarily a reflection of housekeeping around the discount rate and earnings trajectory, rather than a shift in the structural view on Indian Energy Exchange.

news.title: IEX: Power Market Modernization Will Drive Volumes Amid Regulatory And Rate Risks
news.body: Analysts have slightly trimmed their price target on Indian Energy Exchange, citing a modest uptick in the assumed discount rate and valuation multiple, even as fair value remains steady around ₹149.50 and long term profitability expectations are largely unchanged. Analyst Commentary Recent research updates indicate that, while headline target prices for comparable industrial and infrastructure names have seen modest reductions, sentiment around Indian Energy Exchange remains broadly constructive, with the stock still viewed as a structural beneficiary of power market modernization in India.
